title: CreateCodingAgentOptions
description: Options for createCodingAgent(). Extends AgentConfigOverrides with session, extension, and injection-point fields.

cwd.description: Working directory for the agent. Resolved to absolute path.

sessionDirectory.description: Override session storage directory. Defaults to ~/.focuscode/sessions/<sha256(cwd)[:16]>.

sessionId.description: Resume an existing session by id.

persistentSession.description: Persist session to disk. Defaults to true.

extensionPaths.description: Additional extension entry paths. Forbidden in enterprise mode.

approve.description: TypeScript injection point: ApprovalHandler (request: PermissionRequest) => boolean | Promise<boolean>. Not JSON-serializable.

onEvent.description: TypeScript injection point: (event: AgentEvent) => void | Promise<void>. Streaming callback. Not JSON-serializable.

accessTokenProvider.description: TypeScript injection point: () => Promise<string | undefined>. Injects OAuth bearer token into model client. Not JSON-serializable.

shellExecutor.description: TypeScript injection point: ShellExecutor. Override sandbox creation. Not JSON-serializable.

effectSpine.description: Route tool calls through the EffectPort spine for audit. Defaults to config.agent.effectSpine (true).
